rules_satisfied: No production unsafe, unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable
No lossy as conversions — replaced payload.len() as u32 with u32::try_from(payload.len())
Payload length checked against max_payload before encoding
Clippy passes with all strict lints enabled
Smallest source change: added bounds check and checked cast only
residual_risk: None. Both behavior tests pass, clippy clean, no Holzman violations remain. The only changes were: (1) added payload.len() > max_payload guard returning FrameError::PayloadTooLarge, and (2) replaced usize-to-u32 lossy cast with u32::try_from returning FrameError::Overflow on failure.
